spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on the 1H chart when price crosses above the 20 EMA and the next candle closes above the prior high, with a 2x ATR stop and 1.8R target.
assumptions: Asset BTC/USDT on Bybit compiled as Binance spot BTCUSDT; venue difference ignored.
Timeframe is 1H as stated for EMA and chart.
"moves above the 20 EMA" compiled as close crosses_above 20-period EMA, not just close above EMA.
Two-bar sequence encoded with offsets: cross occurred on previous bar (offset 1) and current close above previous high (close gt high[1]).
"current price" for SL/TP interpreted as entry price with ATR taken at the signal bar per engine convention.
No indicator exit stated, so position is held until stop or target hits; exit array is empty.
Claimed 494.47% period interpreted as backtest since January 2021, compiled as period_start 2021-01-01; exact end date not stated so period_end left null.

evidence.quote: on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
Every time the price moves above the 20 EMA on the 1H chart of BTC/USDT on Bybit
If the next candle closed above the previous candle's high, you long.
SL will be at the current price - (2 * ATR indicator)
TP will be at the current price + 1.8 * (current price - SL price )
